title: The New Seven Wonders of the World
examples: Which of these wonders is in India?
What is the Great Wall famous for?
Can you tell me about the Colosseum?

explain.say: Today we say about the New Seven Wonders of the World. These are very famous man-made places. We will learn about seven amazing sites today.

draw.text: The New Seven Wonders of the World

explain.say: First we say the Great Wall of China. It is a very long defensive wall. People built it to protect their kingdom.

draw.text: Great Wall of China: Long Wall

explain.say: Next we say Petra in Jordan. It is a city carved into rock. The colors there are very beautiful to see.
Then we say Christ the Redeemer in Brazil. This statue stands high up on a mountain. It looks like Jesus Christ.
We say Machu Picchu in Peru next. It is an old Inca citadel high in the mountains. It is very mysterious to visit.
Now we say Chichen Itza in Mexico. This site has many large stone pyramids. It was built by the Maya people.

faq.a: Some of these wonders are very old, but some were built more recently. The Great Wall is very ancient.
asks: Are these all from the same time?

faq.q: Did all the people who built these wonders live near each other?
faq.a: No, these wonders are spread across many different continents. They are in different countries worldwide.
asks: Are they all in one country?

faq.q: What is the difference between a wonder and a monument?
faq.a: A wonder is usually a very famous and impressive site. A monument is a structure built to remember someone or something.
asks: Is a wonder the same as a landmark?

faq.q: Is it hard to visit all of them?
faq.a: Yes, because they are so far apart. You would need to travel to many different countries.
asks: Can I see them all in one trip?
How difficult is it to travel to these sites?

faq.q: Who decided which ones were the New Seven Wonders?
faq.a: A global committee selected these sites based on their historical and architectural importance. It was a worldwide vote.

facts: The Great Wall of China is not one continuous wall.
Petra is famous for its rock-cut architecture.
Machu Picchu was built for the Inca civilization.
The Colosseum was used for public spectacles in ancient Rome.

quiz.say: Which wonder is located in Peru and was built by the Inca?
quiz.why: Machu Picchu is correctly identified as the Inca citadel in Peru.

wrong.0: The Colosseum is in Italy, which is a different country.
wrong.1: Petra is in Jordan, not Peru.
wrong.3: Chichen Itza is in Mexico, not Peru.

quiz.say: A structure carved into natural rock, like Petra, is an example of:
quiz.why: Petra shows that structures can be carved directly into natural rock.

wrong.0: Pyramids are usually built up, not carved out.
wrong.1: A wall is built along the ground, not carved into it.
wrong.2: Statues are usually freestanding, not carved into rock faces.

quiz.say: The Colosseum was primarily used for:
quiz.why: The Colosseum's design was perfect for large public shows and games.

wrong.1: While religious items were present, its main function was entertainment.
wrong.2: It was an arena for the public, not a place to live.
wrong.3: It was an open arena, not a place for soldiers to stay.
